description_expanded: OverviewGulf FrontHot TubGulf Front Home-3 Gulf Front Master Suites-Private Pool-Beach Chairs 'Bula'The Space Bula – Gulf-Front Luxury with Stunning Views & Private Walkover! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Absolutely Breathtaking Gulf Views – Panoramic scenery from every level Gulf-Front Porches on All 3 Floors – Perfect for soaking in the ocean breeze & sunsets State-of-the-Art Kitchen – Fully equipped for gourmet meals & entertaining Private Swim/Spa Hot Tub – Relax with ocean views & ultimate comfort First-Floor Entertainment Room – 65” curved TV, surround sound, & bar area Ping Pong Table & Game Table – Fun for guests of all ages! Three Master Suites with En-Suite Bathrooms – Spacious & luxurious accommodations Private Walkover to the Beach – Just steps from the water’s edge Outdoor Sand Room & Shower – Convenient for storing beach gear & rinsing off Sonos Sound System Throughout – Enjoy music inside & on the decks Driveway Parking for 4 Cars – Private off-street parking in a quiet neighborhood Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experienceTWO SETS OF FREE BEACH CHAIRS - Seasonally March - OctoberWelcome to BulaBula is a beachfront home with three master (en suite) bedrooms and a private walkover just steps from the water's edge.The first floor is our "Fun" room. It has a 65" curved TV with surround sound and an L-shaped sofa perfect for the best of movie watching. There is also a bar area with a beverage center and ice maker; a game table for playing cards and board games; and a ping pong table. A large full bath with a steam shower completes this floor.The second floor has a large living space: a living room with a gas fireplace; a dining room that seats ten, and an elegant seashell chandelier; and, a well-equipped kitchen with a bar that seats four. Behind the kitchen is a large laundry room with a washer and dryer, a utility sink, and an extra refrigerator. A beautiful half bath sits across from the stairway. The Master Suite, also located on the first floor, has a king-size bed, a gas fireplace, amazing views, and French doors to the deck. Off the bedroom, there is a large walk-in master closet and ensuite bath with two sinks and a separate vanity with a lighted make-up mirror and stool. The walk-in shower for two has a bench seat, a shower head at each end, and a rain can in the middle.The third floor has four bedrooms--three beachside. Two suites anchor the corners of the house. The Sunrise Suite is on the Southeast corner and has views in both directions, a walk-in closet and a bath with a double vanity, a walk-in shower, and a private toilet room. The Sunset Suite sits on the Southwest corner and has a beach view as well as a beautiful sunset view. The ensuite bath has a walk-in shower and a private toilet room. The Queen bedroom is in between the two suites on the beach side of the house and has a Queen-sized bed. This room shares a bath in the hall with the bunk room. The bunk room is on the front of the house and has two sets of bunk beds, each with individual lights for reading. The hall bath has a shower over a tub and a private toilet room. All three beach-side bedrooms on this floor have French doors that lead out to the deck.The first-floor deck has a pool and a double chaise lounge. The second-floor deck has a dining table with seating for ten; a conversation area with a love seat, two comfortable chairs and a low table; and off the master bedroom side of this deck, we have two chaise lounges. The third-floor deck has two large swings. The public parts of the house and the decks are all outfitted with speakers and Sonos.Along the west side of the house, private steps lead from the beach to the first-floor deck and private pool/with a heat option, the grilling patio, the private outdoor shower, and our great sand room. The sand room is accessible from the outside of the house and is a great area for you to hang wet towels and store sand toys and chairs.There is NO street parking in Gulf Trace which makes it a very private area. We offer off-street parking for three to four cars.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival*** There is construction next to the house.* Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st* Notification required one week prior to arrival to add pool heat* Fee $50 per day and required for length of stay* Pool heat max temperature is 87 degrees* Pool heat is not guaranteed** This home has a pool alarm required by Florida law which cannot be disabled.* Guests will be held responsible for any damage to the alarm.** Please note as of January 1, 2022, HOA prohibits the use of golf carts in the community of Gulf Trace **SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (12):Second Floor - Master Bedroom - King-sized bed, private en suite bathroomThird Floor - Master Bedroom - King-sized bed, private en suite bathroomThird Floor - Master Bedroom - King-sized bed, private en suite bathroomThird Floor - Guest Bedroom - Queen-sized bed, shared bathroomThird Floor - Bunk Bedroom - Twin over twin and Full over Full Bunk beds, Shared bathroomAREA ATTRACTIONS:Take home a piece of Grayton Beach by picking up a painting or sculpture from the Grayton Artist Collective; or, stop at a boutique like Petunia’s to browse a number of gifts and treasures. Escape from it all with a hike through Grayton Beach State Park — from here, the sight of sand dunes will leave you in awe.At the end of the day, stroll along this beach neighborhood’s sugar-white sand and watch the sunset. Grab a memorable meal at favorites like Coast or Hurricane Oyster Bar & Grill, and then listen to some live music at Red Bar or AJ's Restaurant. The property sits halfway between the new Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport in Panama City and the Northwest Florida Regional Airport in Fort Walton Beach. With multiple American, Delta, United/Continental and Southwest flights daily, Grayton Beach is easy to get to from anywhereShow less
